title: nianzhibai/91
why_good: A self-hosted private video site that aggregates multiple Chinese cloud drives (115, PikPak, 123, etc.) and supports 302 direct playback to avoid bandwidth costs, plus a short-video mode and one-time share links.
value: Chinese users with large video libraries pay for a hassle-free setup and ongoing support to access their videos anywhere without bandwidth costs.
risk: 115 or PikPak could integrate a similar feature natively, killing the need for a third-party tool.
does: A self-hosted private video site that aggregates multiple Chinese cloud drives (115, PikPak, 123, etc.) and supports 302 direct playback to avoid bandwidth costs, plus a short-video mode and one-time share links.
why_use: It solves the pain of managing scattered videos across Chinese cloud drives by providing a unified, fast, and private interface, with 302 mode saving bandwidth and a short-video mode for casual browsing.
gap: Only geeks can self-host it; no managed product around the capability for non-technical users.
counter: Cloud drive providers themselves (115, PikPak) could add a similar video browsing feature, and the niche is small; also, self-hosted tools like OpenList already exist, making this a feature not a company.
differentiator: Package it as a one-click appliance for ordinary Chinese users, with a web-based setup wizard and pre-configured cloud drive integrations, plus a mobile-friendly UI.
hook: Chinese users with large video collections on 115/PikPak/123 pan who want a private, ad-free, TikTok-style browsing experience without re-downloading or paying for cloud bandwidth.

zh.claim: 个人私有视频站，支持多网盘接入、低带宽播放、短视频模式、一次性分享。
zh.hook: 在115/PikPak/123等网盘存了大量视频的中国用户，想要一个无广告、私密的抖音式浏览体验，又不想重新下载或为云带宽付费。
zh.does: 一个自托管的私有视频站，聚合多个中国云盘（115、PikPak、123等），支持302直连播放以节省带宽，还有短视频模式和一次性分享链接。
zh.why_use: 解决了跨多个中国云盘管理散落视频的痛点，提供统一、快速、私密的界面，302模式省带宽，短视频模式适合休闲刷片。
zh.gap: 只有极客能用——安装需要命令行或Docker，没有面向非技术用户的管理服务或友好产品。
zh.counter: 云盘提供商（如115、PikPak）自己可能添加类似视频浏览功能，且这个市场很小；另外已有OpenList等自托管工具，这更像一个功能而非公司。
zh.differentiator: 将其打包为面向普通中国用户的一键设备，提供网页设置向导和预配置的云盘集成，加上移动端友好的界面。
zh.value: 拥有大量视频库的中国用户付费获得无忧设置和持续支持，以便随时随地访问视频而无需带宽成本。
zh.risk: 115或PikPak可能原生集成类似功能，从而消灭第三方工具的需求。
zh.why_good: 一个自托管的私有视频站，聚合多个中国云盘（115、PikPak、123等），支持302直连播放以节省带宽，还有短视频模式和一次性分享链接。

consumer_angle: A plug-and-play private video streaming service for families or small groups that aggregates Chinese cloud drives without technical setup.
pick_reason: Strong maintenance signals but no verified willingness to pay; gap is clear but wedge requires packaging for non-technical users.
